protocol.user_sampling: uniform eligible users with replacement; reconstruction then independent terminal users
protocol.output_head: full CE over real items 1..itemnum; labels ID-1; tied embedding; no bias; PAD/MASK excluded
protocol.negative_sampling: diagnostic only; unused by training CE
protocol.reconstruction: latest maxlen events; 0.15 MASK-only with one-target fallback
protocol.terminal_context: strict prefix of at most maxlen-1 events plus MASK

metric_definitions.coefficient_mass: Sum of per-target objective coefficients across updates; neither loss-value share nor gradient share
metric_definitions.branch_ce: Summed real-item catalog CE divided by that branch's valid target count
metric_definitions.endpoint_selections: Terminal targets at the full training-history endpoint; includes n=2 exceptions
metric_definitions.cutoff_index: Zero-based target occurrence in the full training history
metric_definitions.context_length: Number of preceding events retained before appended MASK
metric_definitions.mean_probability_of_selected_target: Mean policy probability assigned to the realized target; not an empirical frequency
metric_definitions.scope: Training measurements only; diagnostic-loader terminal coverage cannot reconstruct this allocation
